verdict.rationale: Cloudflare Sandboxes is an SDK-first product where essentially all functionality (exec, file I/O, sessions, tunnels, snapshots, port exposure, git, docker) is exposed programmatically via the SDK/API, and even the browser-based terminal UI is explicitly built on top of the same WebSocket/API layer rather than being a separate privileged surface, implying no UI-only capability gap by design (cloudflare-sandbox-docs-1,7,8,9,10,15,21,22,31). Missing for 10: an explicit vendor statement claiming full UI/API parity, and independent/hands-on confirmation that no dashboard-only controls exist beyond what the SDK exposes.
